function: CSI feedback with learned channel prediction at the BS; a light-weight predictor function at the UE avoids ML there (pp. 1-2).
system: Massive MIMO downlink, 64-antenna rooftop BS and single-antenna UEs, OFDM at 2.18 GHz, no RIS (pp. 2, 8-9).
method: Supervised RNN, BiLSTM and hybrid RNN plus NeuralProphet channel predictors trained at the BS with Huber loss and Adam; predictor function derived from predictions (pp. 4, 8-9).
data_channel: Measured Nokia Bell-Labs Stuttgart campaign data, track-1 for training (pp. 8-9); synthetic AR model for multiuser (p. 9); MATLAB nrCDLChannel set for the CsiNet comparison (p. 12).
test_conditions: Train on track-1 (80/10/10 split); test on tracks 1, 2, 12, stated unseen in training (pp. 9-10); CsiNet comparison on 15k nrCDLChannel samples (p. 12).
baselines: Non-learned: conventional feedback without ML (periodic round-robin); learned: RNN, BiLSTM, NeuralProphet predictors, MLaBE (ML at both ends), CsiNet autoencoder (pp. 8, 10-12).
metrics: NMSE, cosine similarity and precoding gain (pp. 10-11).
complexity: 5.8 M FLOPs for single-step prediction versus 58.52 M for CsiNet (p. 12); 4096 parameters to report versus 0.35 M for MLaBE (p. 11).
openness: none; only open-source libraries (TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn) are used, no code or data link (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "a measurement campaign was performed at Nokia Bell-Labs campus in Stuttgart, Germany"; p. 9: "To train CPs, we used dataset of track-1"
q2_support: p. 10: "different tracks, which were unseen by the CPs during the training phase"; p. 10: "each track has different channel strength"
q3_support: p. 11: "CSILaBS shows approximately 11% improvement in comparison to without ML"; p. 11: "CSILaBS gives nearly same gain as using ML at both ends (MLaBE)"; p. 12: "we compare the performance of CSILaBS with state-of-the-art, i.e., autoencoder [8], named CsiNet"
q4_support: p. 12: "the number of floating-point operations for single-step prediction of CSILaBS are 5.8 M, which are very few in comparison to CsiNet (58.52 M)"
q5_support: p. 8: "a measurement campaign was performed at Nokia Bell-Labs campus in Stuttgart, Germany"; p. 9: "More details of the dataset are available in [5]"
notes: Area 2: the learned channel predictor (RNN, BiLSTM, RNN plus NeuralProphet) feeds a CSI feedback scheme. The multiuser feedback selection (Glauber dynamics) is not learned and uses synthetic AR channels (p. 9). q2 rests on tracks 2 and 12, other recordings of the same campus campaign; Fig. 6 (p. 10) also shows track 1, whose test part is held out from the training track; reviewer to confirm. q5 rests on the clause 'or on measured data': the measured dataset is not released with a link or DOI in this paper, which points to [5] for details; reviewer to confirm. The CsiNet comparison uses MATLAB nrCDLChannel (p. 12), which the paper does not tie to 3GPP TR 38.901.
